completed_work.details: Sidebar navigation now exposes Users, Organizations, Permissions, Jobs, Workflows, Approvals, Reviews, Artifacts, Dashboard, Modules, Settings, Errors, Memory Events, Logs, Agents, and Products.
Permission-denied entries are shown as locked/disabled instead of hidden for productized routes.
Organizations, Permissions, Memory Events, Modules, Products, and Settings placeholders were replaced with API-backed product UI.
Agents, Jobs, Workflows, Artifacts, Reviews, Approvals, Errors, and Memory Events now expose list, detail, loading, empty, error, and action/create UI where backend APIs exist.
Module registry, module resource registry, adapter mapping, execution provider mapping, live gate readiness, and policy surfaces are visible.
Job creation/event UI and workflow/agent/product job request UI are exposed through existing metadata-only jobs APIs.
